name: read_text
description: Read inline text or one tagged file source with a character limit and structured truncation information.
scheme_source: (define-tool (list (list 'name "read_text") (list 'description "Read inline text or one file with a character limit.") (list 'parameters (list (list "source" "any" "Inline text or (files path)." #t) (list "limit" "integer" "Maximum returned characters; defaults to 1048576." #f))) (list 'procedure (lambda (arguments) (let* ((source (field-ref arguments "source" "")) (limit (field-ref arguments "limit" 1048576)) (text (if (string? source) source (field-ref (read-file (list-ref source 2)) 'text ""))) (total (string-length text)) (count (min total (max 0 limit)))) (list (list "text" (list->string (list-head (string->list text) count))) (list "total_characters" total) (list "returned_characters" count) (list "truncated" (< count total))))))))
replaces_pattern: cat PATH, with exactly one simple, unquoted file path and no options, redirections, pipelines, or compound commands.
rationale: Avoids shell startup and returns bounded text with explicit truncation metadata in one call.
stability_contract: For identical arguments and unchanged file contents, every result field and its ordering is deterministic. The limit counts characters; no host metadata is returned. Legacy rendering is exact when truncated is false.
translate_source: (lambda (command) (let ((parts (string-split (string-trim command) " "))) (if (and (= (length parts) 2) (string=? (list-ref parts 1) "cat")) (let ((path (list-ref parts 2))) (if (and (> (string-length path) 0) (not (string-prefix? "-" path)) (not (string-contains? path "..")) (= (length (filter (lambda (ch) (or (char-alphabetic? ch) (char-numeric? ch) (char=? ch #\/) (char=? ch #\.) (char=? ch #\_) (char=? ch #\-))) (string->list path))) (string-length path))) (list (list "source" (list 'files path)) (list "limit" 1048576)) #f)) #f)))
